The '''Morita conjectures''' in [[general topology]] are certain problems about [[normal space]]s, now solved in the affirmative. The [[conjecture]]s, formulated by [[Kiiti Morita]] in 1976, ask

# If <math>X \times Y</math> is normal for every normal space ''Y'', is ''X'' a [[discrete space]]?
# If <math>X \times Y</math>  is normal for every normal [[P-space#P-spaces in the sense of Morita|P-space]] ''Y'', is ''X'' [[metrizable]]?<ref>{{cite book|first=Kiiti|last= Morita|authorlink=Kiiti Morita| contribution=Some problems on normality of products of spaces|editor-first=Josef |editor-last= Novák| title= General topology and its relations to modern analysis and algebra, IV (Proc. Fourth Prague Topological Sympos., Prague, 1976), Part B|publisher= Soc. Czechoslovak Mathematicians and Physicists|location= Prague|year=1977|pages= 296–297|mr=0482657}}</ref>
# If <math>X \times Y</math>  is normal for every normal countably [[paracompact]] space ''Y'', is ''X'' metrizable and [[sigma-locally compact]]?

The answers were believed to be affirmative. Here a '''normal P-space''' ''Y'' is characterised by the property that the product with every metrizable ''X'' is normal; thus the conjecture was that the [[converse (logic)|converse]] holds.

Keiko Chiba, Teodor C. Przymusiński, and [[Mary Ellen Rudin]]<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Chiba|first1=Keiko|last2=Przymusinski|first2=Teodor C.|last3=Rudin|first3=Mary Ellen|author3-link=Mary Ellen Rudin|year=1986|title=Normality of product spaces and Morita's conjectures|journal=[[Topology and Its Applications]]|volume=22|issue=1|pages=19–32|doi=10.1016/0166-8641(86)90074-X|mr=0831178|doi-access=}}</ref> [[mathematical proof|proved]] conjecture (1) and showed that conjectures (2) and (3) cannot be proven false under the standard [[Zermelo–Fraenkel set theory|ZFC]] axioms for mathematics (specifically, that the conjectures hold under the [[axiom of constructibility]] ''V=L''). 

Fifteen years later, [[Zoltán Tibor Balogh]] succeeded in showing that conjectures (2) and (3) are true.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Balogh|first=Zoltán|authorlink=Zoltán Tibor Balogh|year=2001|title=Nonshrinking open covers and K. Morita's duality conjectures|journal=[[Topology and Its Applications]]|volume=115|issue=3|pages=333–341|doi=10.1016/S0166-8641(00)00067-5|mr=1848133|doi-access=}}</ref>
